# Invite member
{: .no_toc }

Invite people by email (or add an existing user, staff only).
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ORG-04` |
| **Route** | `/orgs/:orgId/members/invite` · deep link `substratal://orgs/:orgId/members/invite` |
| **Where** | Personal › Organizations |
| **Who can use it** | org_admin; organizations.manage may add by user_id |
| **Kind** | form |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwDialog` with `AdwPreferencesGroup` |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Emails | token-field | body.email (one request per address) | paste a list separated by commas/newlines | custom entry with pills |
| Role | radio-group | body.role org_admin \ | member | GtkCheckButton group |
| Add existing user | user-picker | body.user_id | organizations.manage only | AdwDialog with GtkSearchEntry list |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Send invitations | `POST /organizations/{id}/members × n` | Per-address results summary; 409 → "already a member" per address. Responses look identical whether or not the address has an account (by design). |

## Good to know

- Existing Users also receive an `account.organization_invitation` platform alert (NTF-01, and a push where the Hub has a device).
